about.title: Selma Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Losing a family member in a collision on a Selma road changes everything, often in an instant. While Selma's most recent full-year crash data shows no traffic deaths, injury collisions still happen regularly along corridors like Floral Avenue, Highland Avenue, Mccall Avenue, and Golden State Boulevard, and serious crashes can turn tragic. California law gives certain surviving family members, starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children, the right to pursue a wrongful death claim against the party responsible. These cases can account for funeral and burial costs, the financial support a loved one would have provided, and the loss of their companionship and guidance. LawProactive doesn't practice law ourselves; we're a free service that connects grieving families in Selma with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain the options, without any pressure or upfront fees.

whyChoose.title: Why Selma Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Standing Rules Can Be Confusing
items.desc: California limits who can file a wrongful death claim, usually starting with a spouse, domestic partner, or children before other dependents or heirs. An attorney can help your family understand where you fit and what that means for your case.

items.title: The Clock Starts at the Date of Death
items.desc: You generally have two years from the date your loved one passed to file a wrongful death claim, though that window shrinks if a government entity is involved. Waiting too long can close off options, so early guidance matters.

items.title: Losses Go Beyond the Bills
items.desc: California law recognizes more than just funeral costs and lost financial support; it also accounts for the loss of a loved one's companionship and guidance. An independent attorney can help make sure that full picture is part of any claim.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case?
items.answer: No, they're separate matters. A criminal case, if one is filed, is brought by the state and focuses on punishment. A wrongful death claim is a civil action pursued by surviving family members to recover financial losses, and it can move forward regardless of what happens criminally.

items.question: Why haven't I heard about serious crashes near Floral Avenue or Golden State Boulevard in Selma?
items.answer: Public crash records show injury collisions do happen along corridors like Floral Avenue, Highland Avenue, Mccall Avenue, and Golden State Boulevard, with Fridays between 3 and 5 p.m. showing more reported crashes than other times. These records reflect injury collisions, not necessarily fatalities, but any serious crash can escalate quickly.

items.question: Who in my family can actually file the claim?
items.answer: Under California law, a spouse, domestic partner, or children typically have the first right to file. If none exist, other dependents or heirs may be eligible, and an independent attorney can help sort out exactly who qualifies in your family's situation.
